required_sql:
select d.occurred_on, d.cta_id, d.cta_location, d.destination_path,
       sum(d.site_clicks)::bigint as site_clicks,
       sum(d.download_clicks)::bigint as download_clicks
from public.analytics_site_cta_daily d
join public.analytics_site_sources s
  on s.id = d.site_source_id and s.workspace_id = d.workspace_id
where d.environment = 'production'
  and 'infinite.fast' = any(s.production_hosts)
  and d.occurred_on >= current_date - 27
group by d.occurred_on, d.cta_id, d.cta_location, d.destination_path
order by d.occurred_on, d.cta_id, d.cta_location;
proof_sql:
with required_read as (
  select d.occurred_on, d.cta_id, d.cta_location, d.destination_path,
         sum(d.site_clicks)::bigint as site_clicks,
         sum(d.download_clicks)::bigint as download_clicks
  from public.analytics_site_cta_daily d
  join public.analytics_site_sources s
    on s.id = d.site_source_id and s.workspace_id = d.workspace_id
  where d.environment = 'production'
    and 'infinite.fast' = any(s.production_hosts)
    and d.occurred_on >= current_date - 27
  group by d.occurred_on, d.cta_id, d.cta_location, d.destination_path
)
select
  'cta' as receipt,
  count(*)::bigint as row_count,
  min(occurred_on)::text as first_date,
  max(occurred_on)::text as last_date,
  count(distinct occurred_on)::bigint as date_count,
  coalesce(sum(site_clicks), 0)::bigint as total_site_clicks,
  coalesce(sum(download_clicks), 0)::bigint as total_download_clicks,
  md5(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(required_read)::text, E'\n' order by occurred_on, cta_id, cta_location, destination_path), '')) as rowset_md5
from required_read;
